25/S0.subgoal: Explain why human factors are important in the context of interactive XR systems.

25/S1.subgoal: Describe the components of an XR system and how interaction and perceptual design are used to create an illusion of reality.

25/S2.subgoal: Explain the biological mechanisms of perception and the potential outcomes of using artificial stimulation to fool the human brain.

25/S3.subgoal: Describe what perceptual psychology is and its significance for XR hardware and software development.

25/S4.subgoal: Describe the six human senses, including their sensory organs and the types of receptors involved.
